title: Build a Property Tour With Claude: 7 Prompts (one picture, no 3D artist)
instagram:
Claude built this property tour in an afternoon 🏙️

❌ Most developers still send buyers a PDF brochure
✅ This is a link they can click through, outside and inside

The whole build is 7 prompts, one page each:

1️⃣ Plan the project: views, captions, facts, palette
2️⃣ Make one master picture of the building
3️⃣ Turn it into 7 views from that one picture
4️⃣ Build the tour site in one HTML file
5️⃣ Make it feel alive: fades, hover, phone layout
6️⃣ Optional: add moving shots from any video model
7️⃣ Pitch it to a developer

The honest part:
Studios quote about $1,500 for a CGI walkthrough and $20,000+ for an interactive build. Your demo is a sample, not a finished product. Label every render as a concept, and never show AI views of a real project the developer didn't approve.

The building here is fictional: Halo Sky Residences, made for this demo.
